source.note: Full text of ASME BPVC Section II, Part B (Nonferrous Material Specifications) — SB-818 - Specification for Cobalt-Chromium-Nickel-Molybdenum-Tungsten Alloy (UNS R31233) Plate, Sheet, and Strip — as supplied by Daniel Velasquez on 2026-09-07 and extracted from the supplied PDF with marker-pdf. `data` is the extractor's output verbatim — the drop's own `document`, `part`, `figures` and `pages` blocks, with the page-by-page block tree, its HTML, tables and layout coordinates unedited. This file IS the source document, so `transcribed_from` names its own path: it is the artefact under review, not a transcription of one. The volume was supplied as one combined PDF and cut into parts at its own headings, so this file is a page-range slice of a single extraction and its page ids (PDF pages None–None, no printed page numbers on these pages) are the combined document's own, not renumbered from 0. Front matter (cover and title page, contents, list of sections, foreword, statement of policy, personnel, correspondence, summary of changes, cross-referencing) and back matter (back cover) were deleted from the drop before supply and are NOT filed; the drop's `content.json`, `index.json`, `meta.json` and `README.md` are retained beside the kind folders, unfiled, for the same reason. The edition — 2025 Edition (ASME BPVC.II.B-2025), issued 2025-07-01 — is stated on the title page, which this drop no longer carries as a filed cut: it survives only inside the retained `content.json`, so no filed cut of this standard prints its own edition. This cut carries no figure.

children.html: SPECIFICATION FOR COBALT-CHROMIUM-NICKEL-MOLYBDENUM-TUNGSTEN ALLOY (UNS R31233) PLATE, SHEET, AND STRIP
(Identical with ASTM Specification B818-03(2013) except for requiring a report of the test results.)
SPECIFICATION FOR COBALT-CHROMIUM-NICKEL-MOLYBDENUM-TUNGSTEN ALLOY (UNS R31233) PLATE, SHEET, AND STRIP
[Identical with ASTM Specification B 818-03(2013) except for requiring a report of the test results.]
1.1 This specification covers cobalt-chromium-nickelmolybdenum-tungsten alloy UNS R31233 in the form of rolled plate, sheet, and strip for wear applications and general corrosion service.
1.2 The following products are covered under this specification:
1.2.1 Sheet and Strip—Hot or cold rolled, annealed and descaled unless solution-annealing is performed in an atmosphere yielding a bright finish.
1.3 The values stated in inch-pound units are to be regarded as the standard. The values given in parentheses are for information only.

1.4 This standard does not purport to address all of the safety concerns, if any, associated with its use. It is the responsibility of the user of this standard to become familiar with all hazards including those identified in the appropriate Material Safety Data Sheet for this product/ material as provided by the manufacturer, to establish appropriate safety and health practices, and determine the applicability of regulatory limitations prior to use.
B 906 Specification for General Requirements for Flat-Rolled Nickel and Nickel Alloys Plate, Sheet, and Strip
3.1 Definitions of Terms Specific to This Standard:
3.1.1 plate—material 3 ⁄ 16 in. (4.76 mm) and over in thickness.
3.1.2 sheet and strip—material under 3 ⁄ 16 in. (4.76 mm) in thickness.
4.1 Material furnished under this specification shall conform to the applicable requirements of Specification B 906 unless otherwise provided herein.

5.1 It is the responsibility of the purchaser to specify all requirements that are necessary for material ordered under this specification. Examples of such requirements include, but are not limited to, the following:
5.1.2 Dimensions—Thickness (in decimals of an inch), width, and length (inch or fraction of an inch).
5.1.3 Certification—A report of test results is required (see Specification B 906, Section 21).
5.1.4 Optional Requirement—Plate; state how plate is to be cut (see Specification B 906, Table A2.3).
5.1.5 Purchase Inspection—State which tests or inspections are to be witnessed (see Specification B 906, Section 18).
5.1.6 Samples, for Product (Check) Analysis—State whether samples should be furnished (see Specification B 906, Section 7.2.2).
6.1 The material shall conform to the requirements as to chemical composition prescribed in Table 1.
Elongation in 2 in. (50.8 mm) or 4D (A) min % 15
(A) D refers to the diameter of the tension specimen.
6.2 If a product (check) analysis is made by the purchaser, the material shall conform to the requirements specified in Table 1 and Specification B 906.
7.1 Tensile Properties—The material shall conform to the room temperature tensile properties prescribed in Table 2.

8.1.1 Sheet and Strip—The thickness shall be measured with the micrometer spindle 3 ⁄ 8 in. (9.525 mm) or more from any edge for material 1 in. (25.4 mm) or over in width and at any place on material under 1 in. in width.
8.2.1 Sheet and Strip—Sheet and strip may be ordered to cut lengths, in which case a variation of 1 ⁄ 8 in. (3.175 mm) over the specified length shall be permitted, with a "0" minus tolerance.

8.3.1 The edgewise curvature (depth of chord) of flat sheet, strip, and plate shall not exceed the product of 0.05 in. multiplied by the length in feet (0.04 mm multiplied by the length in centimetres).
8.3.2 Straightness for coiled strip is subject to agreement between the manufacturer and the purchaser.
8.4 Squareness (Sheet)—For sheets of all thicknesses and widths of 6 in. (152.4 mm) or more, the angle between adjacent sides shall be 90 ± 0.15° (1 ⁄ 16 in. in 24 in. or 2.6 mm/m).
8.5 Flatness—Plate, sheet, and strip shall be commercially flat.
8.6.1 Plates shall have sheared, abrasive cut, or plasma torch-cut edges as specified.
8.6.2 Sheet and strip shall have sheared or slit edges.

9.1 Each plate, sheet, or strip shall be marked on one face with the specification number, heat number, manufacturer's identification, and size. The markings shall have no deleterious effect on the material or its performance and shall be sufficiently stable to withstand normal handling.

9.2 Each bundle or shipping container shall be marked with this specification number; the size; gross, tare, and net weight; consignor and consignee address; contract or order number; and such other information as may be defined in the contract or order.
X1.1 Proper heat treatment during or subsequent to fabrication is necessary for optimum performance and the manufacturer shall be consulted for details.
